Grimdark Future (One Page Rules)

Grimdark Future is One Page Rules' free, miniature-agnostic sci-fi wargame — a streamlined alternative to Warhammer 40k that works with any 28-32mm miniatures. The rules fit on a single page, and the game explicitly encourages using 3D printed, proxy, or converted models.

Scale Details

Miniature Scale
32mm
Ratio Equivalent
1:50
Measurement
eye level
Eye Level Height
32.0mm

Grimdark Future has no official miniature range — it is designed to work with whatever you own. The 32mm recommendation aligns with modern Games Workshop and the majority of 3D printed STL files. The game's flexibility makes it the most accessible entry point for players with custom-printed collections.

Publisher: One Page Rules · Base Sizes: 25mm, 32mm, 40mm, 50mm, 60mm, 80mm, 100mm, 120mm

3D Printing Tips for GDF

Grimdark Future is the ideal game for 3D printing — there are no official models to match, so print whatever you want. Use the game's base size chart to ensure your printed models fit the correct base categories. The forgiving rule system means visual consistency matters less than having the right base size.

Frequently Asked Questions

What scale is Grimdark Future (One Page Rules)?
Grimdark Future (One Page Rules) miniatures are 32mm scale (1:50 ratio), measured eye level. Grimdark Future has no official miniature range — it is designed to work with whatever you own. The 32mm recommendation aligns with modern Games Workshop and the majority of 3D printed STL files. The game's flexibility makes it the most accessible entry point for players with custom-printed collections.
What base sizes does Grimdark Future (One Page Rules) use?
Grimdark Future (One Page Rules) uses the following base sizes: 25mm, 32mm, 40mm, 50mm, 60mm, 80mm, 100mm, 120mm.
What nozzle and layer height should I use for Grimdark Future (One Page Rules) miniatures?
